_: SPY 1D bars as this repo's own /api/bars served them on 2026-09-13 (Massive primary). The LAST 3000 the provider had.
_why_this_many: The HVE column's window is 2,751 bars, so a per-series comparison needs at least that many LOADED or the column is excluded by the compareAll depth gate. SPY clears it; AGEN's provider history does not, and that exclusion is the gate being exercised rather than a gap.
_the_object_lane_slices_this: MAX_RECURRENCE_STEPS caps bars x warm-up at 1,000,000, and v2's accum warms over 250 bars, so the OBJECT lane reads the last 1,400 of these. The slice is taken in the test, beside its reason.
